title: Power of Your love
lyrics_original: The weaknesses I see in me
By the power of Your love.
I'll rise up like the eagle
And I will soar with You
In the power of Your love.
Let me see You face to face
As Your will unfolds in my life
By the power of Your love.
And I will soar with You
In the power of Your love.

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకునా కృప నీకు చాలును, బలహీనతయందు నాశక్తి పరిపూర్ణమగుచున్నదని ఆయన నాతో చెప్పెను. కాగా క్రీస్తు శక్తి నామీద నిలిచియుండు నిమిత్తము, విశేషముగా నా బలహీనతలయందె
bible_verses.english: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.' Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

bible_verses.telugu: మీరు ఈ లోక మర్యాదను అనుసరింపక,  ఉత్తమమును,  అనుకూలమును, సంపూర్ణమునై యున్న దేవుని చిత్తమేదో పరీక్షించి తెలిసికొనునట్లు మీ మనస్సు మారి నూతనమగుటవలన రూపాంతరము పొందుడి.
bible_verses.english: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవాకొరకు ఎదురు చూచువారు నూతన బలము  పొందుదురు  వారు పక్షిరాజులవలె రెక్కలు చాపి పైకి ఎగురుదురు అలయక పరుగెత్తుదురు సొమ్మసిల్లక నడిచిపోవుదురు.
bible_verses.english: but those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, I come to You today just as I am, aware of my weaknesses and in deep need of Your grace. Hold me close and surround me with Your unfailing love. Renew my heart and mind so that I may be transformed by Your presence. Strip away the things that pull me from You, and let Your strength shine through my frailties. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, I come to You today just as I am, aware of my weaknesses and in deep need of Your grace. Hold me close and surround me with Your unfailing love. Renew my heart and mind so that I may be transformed by Your presence. Strip away the things that pull me from You, and let Your strength shine through my frailties. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Coming into God’s presence allows us to drop our pretenses and bring our weaknesses openly to Him. As we rest in His abundant grace, His love goes to work in our hearts, gently stripping away what holds us back and making us new. This song invites us to draw near, letting His embrace shape our desires and transform us from the inside out. When we draw close to Him, His power becomes our strength.
